items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: And we called him Specs because he did wear glasses. He was quite a little arranger.

ctx.x: O-D-U-M. And we called him Specs because he did wear glasses. He was quite a little arranger. Now I think he's still living. And he went on to New York, and he did well. He was writing exclusively -- I have to push this tooth back up again -- for this group of excellent singers.
